focus: D1 correctness - spec-kit retrieval and trigger index

findingDetails.title: The v4.0.0.3 release shipped with a trigger index stale for its own changelog entry
findingDetails.evidence: The last in-range commit touching the index is 903c983c39; six later commits rewrote the changelog entry's title and trigger phrases (80dba263f0, e52309a715, c93029d4d0, 40e2cb521a, 3d5e502e74, bebcf9c349, 364d74b502) and none rebuilt the index: the index blob at v4.0.0.3 equals the blob at HEAD (6dfeb68c81). generate-trigger-index.mjs --check exits 1 on the tagged tree with .skilled/changelog/skilled/v4.0.0.3.md stale (added doctor update command, removed doctor command split). Executed lookups: the current phrase returns two older spec docs and never the entry; the stale phrase still returns the entry at score 1.0. The CI step running the same check is continue-on-error (advisory-checks.yml:55-68).
findingDetails.recommendation: Regenerate the trigger index from the tagged content (node generate-trigger-index.mjs) as part of the release tail, and consider rebuilding it in the same commit as any changelog phrase change so --check stays green.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Compared the tagged index blob with HEAD's, listed the index and changelog commits in range, ran the repo's own --check (exit 1) and both phrase lookups; packet-doc staleness was excluded as branch-local (those docs do not exist at the tag).
